name: pokemon-tcg-versus
description: Pokémon TCG Academy · Versus: the sign-in, lobby and relay app for two-player games (Spacefast Zero).

scripts.check-publish: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.existsSync('.env.server')?fs.readFileSync('.env.server','utf8'):'';if(/^\s*(export\s+)?ALLOW_DEV_GUESTS\s*=/m.test(t)){console.error('check-publish: .env.server sets ALLOW_DEV_GUESTS. Delete .env.server (or that line) before sf publish.');process.exit(1)}console.log('check-publish: ok, ALLOW_DEV_GUESTS is not in .env.server')"
